name: HISD 2025 Dark
_comment: Dark counterpart of hisd-powerbi-theme.json. Values are the [data-theme="dark"] semantics from assets/hisd-theme.css: dark surface/background, brightened teal-led dataColors and tableAccent, foreground #F6F7F7, good=#99CD77, neutral(amber)=#CA8753, bad=#E49292. Ribbon sentinel (page-background SVGs snap to these): ribbonFrom/ribbonTo are the dark gradient endpoints teal-700 #037882 -> dark-green-800 #05463C, ribbonHighlight yellow-400 #FBDE83; ribbonFan is the FIXED canonical 4-stop band (same in every theme). Power BI cannot embed non-installed fonts; Segoe UI is the on-screen stand-in for Radio Canada. Use brand fonts only in exported/static assets.
